_comment: Exact versions, not ranges. DEP-1 in docs/audit-2026-11/.
This file used to say npm:hono@^4.0.0, and deno.lock resolved that range
to 4.12.32 — which is inside the vulnerable range of all five open hono
advisories (patched in >= 4.13.16). The range made it look current while
the lock held it eight minor versions back, and nothing in the repo said
Every import in this function now names one exact version, so the question
'what is deployed' is answerable by reading, and an advisory about either
package can be answered yes or no.
WHEN YOU CHANGE A VERSION HERE, change it in deno.lock too — both the
specifier mapping and the package entry with its registry integrity hash.
There is no deno binary on the usual dev machine here, so the lock is
maintained by hand and the hash comes from
